actions.label: BL-01 node discovery
actions.expected: A blank document exposes only Prompt and Image authoring tools rather than the 17-node Node Library.
actions.actual: Visible tool rail: Prompt, Image, Simulation output, Refresh, Recipes.

actions.label: Capture 01-blank-authoring-tools
actions.expected: Blank-document Build tools are visible after ordinary bootstrap.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Add Prompt from blank tool rail
actions.expected: A Prompt node is added through the visible UI.
actions.actual: Left click at (91, 313).

actions.label: Capture 02-prompt-created
actions.expected: Prompt creation is captured after the real click.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Add Image from blank tool rail
actions.expected: An Image node is added through the visible UI.
actions.actual: Left click at (91, 354).

actions.label: Capture 03-image-created
actions.expected: Image creation is captured after the real click.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Separate the second node with ordinary left drag
actions.expected: The node moves before marquee testing.

actions.label: Capture 04-node-left-drag
actions.expected: The ordinary left drag result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Select the first node with a left marquee
actions.expected: The ordinary left marquee selects its node.

actions.label: Capture 05-left-marquee
actions.expected: The left-marquee result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Add the second node with Shift marquee
actions.expected: Shift marquee preserves the first selection and adds the second.
actions.actual: Shift+left drag (662, 372) to (1012, 646).

actions.label: Capture 06-shift-marquee
actions.expected: The Shift-marquee result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Pan with a right drag
actions.expected: Canvas pans without changing the current node selection or opening a context menu.

actions.label: Capture 07-right-drag-pan
actions.expected: The right-drag pan result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: BL-02 marquee and pointer
actions.expected: Ordinary marquee/pointer ownership is unreliable; Shift marquee does not reliably add to the current selection.
actions.actual: Left marquee selected 1; Shift marquee selected 2.

actions.label: Capture 08-marquee-observation
actions.expected: The recorded marquee observation is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try Ctrl+D graph duplicate
actions.expected: A selected graph object duplicates with a visible offset.
actions.actual: Pressed Control+D.

actions.label: Capture 09-shortcut-duplicate
actions.expected: The Ctrl+D result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try Ctrl+C graph copy
actions.expected: The selected graph object enters the graph clipboard.
actions.actual: Pressed Control+C.

actions.label: Capture 10-shortcut-copy
actions.expected: The Ctrl+C result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try Ctrl+V graph paste
actions.expected: The graph clipboard pastes a duplicate selection.
actions.actual: Pressed Control+V.

actions.label: Capture 11-shortcut-paste
actions.expected: The Ctrl+V result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try Delete graph command
actions.expected: Selected graph objects are removed with graph-aware behavior.
actions.actual: Pressed Delete.

actions.label: Capture 12-shortcut-delete
actions.expected: The Delete result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try Ctrl+Z graph undo
actions.expected: The last graph mutation is undone.
actions.actual: Pressed Control+Z.

actions.label: Capture 13-shortcut-undo
actions.expected: The Ctrl+Z result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: BL-03 graph shortcuts
actions.expected: Ctrl+D, clipboard, Delete, and undo do not provide graph-aware commands when canvas input owns the interaction.
actions.actual: Node counts before/after Ctrl+D/Ctrl+V/Delete/Ctrl+Z: 2/2/2/2/2.

actions.label: Capture 14-shortcut-observation
actions.expected: The recorded shortcut observation is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Edit primary Prompt content inline
actions.expected: The primary authored prompt content enters an inline editor and receives keyboard text.
actions.actual: No inline editor appeared after a real double click.

actions.label: Capture 15-inline-primary-content
actions.expected: The inline-primary-content result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: BL-04 direct primary-content edit
actions.expected: Double-clicking primary node content does not expose a direct canvas editor.
actions.actual: No inline editor appeared for primary content after the real double click.

actions.label: Capture 16-inline-edit-observation
actions.expected: The recorded inline-edit observation is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Select multiple nodes for organization
actions.expected: The two nodes are selected before creating an organizational container.

actions.label: Capture 17-module-selection
actions.expected: The organizational selection result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.expected: Only the Module organization journey is exposed to users.

actions.label: Capture 18-group-command
actions.expected: The Group command result is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try the visible Module command
actions.expected: A selected workflow becomes a locked Module with an organization journey.
actions.actual: Left click at (507, 283).

actions.label: Capture 19-module-command
actions.expected: The Module command result is captured.

actions.expected: Visual Group remains alongside Module, while the Module surface lacks a locked-by-default organization journey.
actions.actual: Group command visible=true; module cards created=0; visible lock controls=0.

actions.label: Capture 20-groups-modules-observation
actions.expected: The recorded Groups/Modules observation is captured.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.
